description: This is a Java source file defining a custom UI component called FloatingActionButton for Android applications. It extends FrameLayout and implements Checkable, providing toggleable behavior and visual outline handling for a floating action button in the UI.

classes.name: FloatingActionButton
classes.description: A custom circular floating action button that maintains checked state and provides callback mechanisms for state changes.

classes.name: FloatingActionButton.OnCheckedChangeListener
classes.description: Interface for a callback to be invoked when the checked state of the FAB changes.

methods.name: FloatingActionButton
methods.description: Constructors for initializing the FAB with context and optional attributes.

methods.name: setChecked
methods.description: Sets the checked state of the button and notifies listener if present.

methods.name: setOnCheckedChangeListener
methods.description: Sets a listener to be invoked when the check state changes.

methods.name: isChecked
methods.description: Returns whether the FAB is currently checked.

methods.name: performClick
methods.description: Overrides click behavior to toggle checked state when clicked.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Handles size change to invalidate and update outline outline.

methods.name: onCreateDrawableState
methods.description: Adds checked state to drawable state array for visual state changes.
